name: Shadow Volume Voxelization
definition: A technique to generate a 3D shadow volume texture by voxelizing scene geometry into a 3D grid, where each voxel stores a bitmask representing which of its 8 constituent sub-voxels are occluded.
summary: Shadow Volume Voxelization generates a 3D shadow texture where each voxel stores an 8-bit occlusion bitmask, enabling multi-resolution shadow representation through mipmaps.
